newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PetSec Q1 net profit A$12.58 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PetSec Q1 net profit A$12.58 mln.

text.p: Petroleum Securities Ltd (PetSec) said it made a net profit for the first quarter of the year to June 30, 1996 of A$12.58 million, which represented further strong profit growth.
PetSec said it did not have comparative figures because this was the first time it had issued quarterly profit figures.
It said its operating profit before interest, tax and abnormal items was A$7.64 million for the quarter.
PetSec the key factors in the higher profit were strong oil prices coupled with increased oil production from Petsec's Gulf of Mexico operations.
Improved efficiencies also boosted profits, it said.
PetSec said it had a A$12.41 million profit on the sale of Petsec's interest in the Didipio gold/copper project to Climax Mining Ltd, which was registered as an abnormal profit.
PetSec's shares rose 11 cents to A$5.12 on Tuesday.
